item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 10/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will cover the coast of Guangdong today. Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will become fine over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, a broad area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea during the weekend and early next week. Meanwhile, a replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China. It will be windier over the region.
